Let's see what we can pull off.
Challenge accepted!
When I get punched/ I punch back!

I'm gonna knock your block off!
Finished saying your prayers?
Unzan and I are unstoppable!
Alright/ let's go a couple rounds!
Anyone who gets in my way gets knocked out!

Jet Upper!

Threefourfivesixseveneight...!
KO!

HAAAA...!

HAAAA...!

HAAAA...!

You've gone and done it now!

Try not to get swept up in this!
Don't lay a hand on my companions!

We'll be your shield.

Let's pair up for this!

My patience has worn out!
Let's kick 'em to the curb!

Fighting on behalf of your deity is a monk's duty.

Me and Unzan'll bust 'em wide open/ Shou!
Let's kick 'em to the curb/ Shou!
Alright Murasa/ we're at our limit here!
Let's finish this/ Shou!
Ma'am! I'm not worth going that far for...
Let us get in on this too/ Chief!
I'm happy to be fighting alongside you/ and so's Unzan.
I'll follow up/ Chief!
Please/ take care of yourself!
We'd gladly give our lives for you!
Please/ don't push yourself too hard Chief!
We'll head out first/ Chief!
We'll strike from the flank/ Chief!
We'll fight together/ Chief!
Assisting you is why we're here!
I'll follow Hijiri's lead!
Me and Unzan'll bust 'em wide open/ Chief!

I'm ashamed I dragged you all down with me...
Rinnosuke! Akyu! Please steer clear!
Rinnosuke! Kosuzu! Please steer clear!
Ichirin to Palanquin Ship! I'm following up!
You're not sinking the ship on our watch!
The ship won't go down before I do!
Murasa/ now's not the time to be protecting me!
Ichirin to Palanquin Ship! I'm following up!
Murasa/ move the boat!
Akyu/ make sure Murasa keeps her hands on the steering wheel!
The ship won't go down before I do!
That was way too reckless/ Akyu!
We'll take care of it/ Akyu.
Leave the rest to us/ Akyu.
Don't overdo it/ Akyu.
Akyu/ take this chance to back up!
I can't let Akyu do all the work.
We've got your back/ Akyu!
I'm good to swap with you anytime/ Akyu.

Your attacks can't even make me blink!
I've got more than enough grit for this!
Were you scared of Unzan or something?
Were you actually planning on fighting like that?
Not doing yourself any favors there.
Was that actually your best shot...?\n　asks Unzan/ shocked.
Lukewarm at best.
Are you holding back for some stupid reason?
Enemies like you are a yen a dozen.
Not one step back...!
I made it through/ but yeesh...
Yeah/ we can keep going!
I've got nothing to fear!
This won't stop us!
We're actually losing ground...?!
That didn't work/ huh...!
Gah! I've gotta regain my footing!
I got swept up in their pace...!
We've had it up to here with you!
You lack decisiveness!
You've got guts...
Tougher than I figured they'd be...
They're a step ahead...?!

You're a real doozy/ aren't you...!
That's how it's done...\n　says Unzan.
Yeah/ no.
You know what they say about smoke and morons.
Sorry/ I didn't mean you.
Dodging? That's a bit out of place for me.
I'm yawning over here.
I know man/ I can't believe it either.
You're gonna have to try harder than that.
There!
Can't get the drop on two sets of eyes!
Heh/ Unzan must've really spooked you!
I can't believe I lost/ to someone like that...
We lost...
Looks like it's time for us to pack it in.
Unzan's throwing in the towel too/ so we're heading back.
We were fighting for Hijiri's sake this time/ damn it...
That's our limit. I'll leave the rest to you all.
Unzan's just as frustrated as I am/ but that's all we can muster...
This might be a little too much for playing with children/ but here we go.
Unzan/ try not to scare them too bad.
I doubt Unzan's as tranquil as the clouds you're used to.
Hey Unzan/ can you make storm clouds?\n　...Yeah/ stupid question.
Good grief. You celestials are real pieces of work/ huh?
You talk a big game/ but let's see you back it up.
I'm going to punch the crap out of you.\n　We can talk after that.
A little yelling's the least of your worries right now.
Nue/ please just listen to us!
We're not gonna let this one slide!
Time for some corporal punishment!
One of us is GOING catch you!
You've got a lot of nerve/ imitating our friends like that!
So/ you're the chief's doppelganger...\n　I'll crush you myself!
You're her splitting image... Makura's no joke.
If you punks have lost your path/ I'll punch you back on it!
Ugh/ I REALLY didn't need to see this!
Wow/ talk about facing yourself.
I've got what it takes to overcome myself!
There you are/ Mehko!
One of us is GOING catch you!
You've got guts/ but you've completely lost your way!
You're trying to overcome yourself/ but that's not the way...!
Guess I've got no choice here...
Now that's a face in DIRE need of a punch!
You can take your ideals and shove 'em!
